annotations.text:
Home page — 3 fresh / modern directions.
All three keep the brand DNA: Georgia serif display, forest + gold palette, soft radius + shadow (no hairline grids), and the editorial-integrity cues (“Editorial preview”, sources shown). Sample residence names are illustrative. Prices left as [FROM PRICE] placeholders.

Fresh Editorial (leading pick). Light ivory ground, airy two-column hero — no dark full-bleed — photo in a soft rounded frame with a sage panel behind, restrained gold, Hanken Grotesk UI type. Calmest and most premium. Tradeoff: loses the current photographic hero's immediate emotional punch.

Warm & Rounded. Cream ground with soft ambient glows, terracotta accent, big rounded shapes + pill nav, centred hero, city pills, friendly Figtree UI type. Most approachable for anxious families. Tradeoff: rounded-everything can read as less authoritative for a high-stakes decision.

Bold & Structured. Hard forest / photo split hero, XL Georgia display against tiny tracked caps, search bar on the seam, dark proof band, Space Grotesk UI type, sharper card edges. Most confident and distinctive. Tradeoff: closest to today's dark hero, so the least of a departure.
